body:
Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ 5d47d22d1916076c45b645c20ac9c0d875a14b43

Verdict CLEAN

No findings. Read #1709 and the full diff. Local merge with upstream/main was already up to date.

- All three named pins passed: filled_pocket_names_the_model, narrow_pocket_names_the_tool, stock_allowance_names_the_clearance_needed.
- cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main: GREEN.
- cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings: GREEN.
- Mutation: disabled the new too_narrow message condition. Both new diagnostic pins went RED; the filled-model pin stayed green. Restored the condition; all three pins went GREEN. Working tree is clean.
- Extra safety case: a blind pocket cut below its closed floor could gouge. The gate ran both blind_floor tests, including the analytic motion checks across entries and stepdowns; both passed.
- Rules: changed files are 371, 98 and 22 lines. No added production unwrap/expect/panic. No golden, PNG, PROCESS_VERSION, dependency, .github or scripts changes. Changelog: and Fixes #1709 are present.

The STEP sample and release gate were not exercised.

Fixed the requested sample-test finding.

- Updated the expected refusal and doc comment. `the_sample_as_imported_refuses_the_3d_pocket_by_name` pins the exact tool-clearance text from the imported STEP sample.
- Added `camcraft_motion::machining3d` to the gate map. The quick gate selected and passed `shared_face_bodies` (5 passed, 1 heavy test ignored).
- Mutation check: disabling the ladder narrow-area flag made the sample pin fail. Restoring it made the pin pass. The old expectation also failed before the update.

Quick gate against upstream/main and clippy for app and motion with all targets and warnings denied are green. The PR body now records the sample coverage.

New head: aa10962369d1b21d6d13e3bf765f4da64c824a88.
Please re-review.
